rules.name: Discord extra Chromium caches
rules.description: Discord Dawn/Service Worker/blob/Shared Dictionary and crash/logs beyond base Cache trio.
rules.notes: Leaves Preferences/Local Storage/Cookies. Regenerates on next launch.

rules.name: Slack extra Chromium caches and logs
rules.description: Slack Dawn caches, Service Worker, blob_storage, Crashpad, app logs.
rules.notes: Does not remove Slack workspace storage/IndexedDB/Cookies.

rules.name: Microsoft Teams classic Electron caches
rules.description: Classic Teams desktop Chromium caches, Application Cache, blob, logs, tmp.
rules.notes: Classic Teams only. Skips IndexedDB/databases/Cookies. May force re-download of media.

rules.name: Microsoft Teams 2.x container caches and logs
rules.description: New Teams (teams2) sandboxed Library Caches and Logs only.
rules.notes: Does not wipe whole UBF8T346G9.com.microsoft.teams tree (would force re-login). Prefer official in-app clear cache when possible.

rules.name: Zoom extra caches and component logs
rules.description: Zoom updater caches, CEF/WebView data caches, auxiliary logs. Not meeting recordings.
rules.notes: Never touch Documents/Zoom or Movies/Zoom recordings. Already covered: Application Support/zoom.us/Logs and Caches/us.zoom.xos.

rules.name: Telegram NSCache and Sparkle caches
rules.description: Telegram app Cache.db/WebKit/Sparkle under Library/Caches.
rules.notes: Safe regenerable. Media downloads live under Group Containers (separate medium rule).

rules.name: Telegram postbox media cache
rules.description: Downloaded chat media under Telegram Group Container account postbox/media.
rules.notes: Large reclaim. Re-downloads from cloud when reopened. Do not delete account postbox databases.

rules.name: WhatsApp Desktop caches and logs
rules.description: WhatsApp Electron/container caches and logs. Not message store DBs.
rules.notes: Skips Local Storage/IndexedDB/Cookies/message databases.

rules.name: Signal Desktop Chromium caches and logs
rules.description: Signal cache dirs only; never sql/db.sqlite or config.json.
rules.notes: Never delete Application Support/Signal/sql or attachments.sqlite/config.json.

rules.name: Skype for Desktop caches and logs
rules.description: Modern Skype Electron caches plus legacy Content cache and logs.
rules.notes: Leaves Cookies/Local Storage. Content is regenerable media cache for classic Skype.

rules.name: Webex and Cisco Spark caches and logs
rules.description: Cisco Spark/Webex disk caches and meeting logs per Cisco clear-cache docs.
rules.notes: Cisco official guidance: clear Caches/Cisco-Systems.Spark and Cisco Spark folders after quit.

rules.name: RingCentral and Glip caches
rules.description: RingCentral Electron/Glip Chromium cache dirs and logs.
rules.notes: Support docs list Glip Cache/Code Cache/GPUCache under Application Support.

rules.name: Notion desktop caches and logs
rules.description: Notion Electron caches (large offline page cache) and logs.
rules.notes: Cloud workspace re-syncs. Leaves IndexedDB/Cookies for session continuity when possible.

rules.name: Linear desktop caches and logs
rules.description: Linear Electron Chromium caches and logs.
rules.notes: Issues live server-side; local cache regenerable.

rules.name: Obsidian Electron caches (not vaults)
rules.description: Obsidian app Chromium caches under Application Support/obsidian only.
rules.notes: Never touch user vault folders or obsidian.json workspace list beyond caches.

rules.name: Evernote caches and logs
rules.description: Evernote desktop cache directories and logs (not local notebooks DB if present).
rules.notes: Prefer cache dirs only; do not wipe Application Support/Evernote wholesale.

rules.name: OneNote for Mac caches and logs
rules.description: OneNote container caches/logs. Not notebook package stores.
rules.notes: Never delete OneNote notebook content under Containers or Documents.

rules.name: Miro desktop caches
rules.description: Miro (realtimeboard) Electron caches and logs.
rules.notes: Boards re-sync from cloud.

rules.name: Loom desktop caches and logs
rules.description: Loom Electron caches/logs. Not user video library exports.
rules.notes: Recordings are cloud-hosted; local cache is regenerable.

rules.name: Dropbox client caches (not synced files)
rules.description: Dropbox app caches and logs only. Never CloudStorage/Dropbox or user files.
rules.notes: Never touch $HOME/Library/CloudStorage/Dropbox or $HOME/Dropbox content.

rules.name: Dropbox .dropbox.cache (report-only)
rules.description: Legacy offline cache folder inside Dropbox root; may hold temporarily un-synced data.
rules.notes: Report size only. Clearing can drop offline-only pending files.

rules.name: Google Drive for Desktop logs and metadata cache
rules.description: DriveFS logs and non-content caches. Content cache is separate medium rule.
rules.notes: Never wipe CloudStorage/GoogleDrive-* file provider trees.

rules.name: Google DriveFS content_cache (offline files)
rules.description: DriveFS per-account content_cache offline materializations.
rules.notes: Frees space but forces re-download of offline files. Close Drive first.

rules.name: OneDrive caches and logs
rules.description: OneDrive client caches/logs; not CloudStorage/OneDrive files.
rules.notes: Never delete CloudStorage/OneDrive-* or user OneDrive Documents.

rules.name: Box Drive caches and logs
rules.description: Box desktop client caches and logs only.
rules.notes: Do not touch CloudStorage/Box-* synced content.

rules.name: Citrix Workspace/Receiver logs and cache
rules.description: Citrix client logs and local cache (not ICA profiles secrets).
rules.notes: Logs/caches only; leave AuthManager and StoreFront configs.

rules.name: AnyDesk cache and logs
rules.description: AnyDesk connection logs and cache; not address book if stored separately.
rules.notes: Prefer logs/cache globs; do not delete service.conf or user.conf credentials.

rules.name: TeamViewer logs and caches
rules.description: TeamViewer log directory and app caches under user Library.
rules.notes: Connections.txt and versioned Logfile.log are safe to age-out.

rules.name: Alfred launcher caches
rules.description: Alfred app and preferences caches (not workflows/snippets).
rules.notes: Does not remove Alfred.alfredpreferences workflows or clipboard history DB.

rules.name: Raycast caches and logs
rules.description: Raycast app caches and logs (not extension settings).
rules.notes: Leaves clipboard history DB and extensions; cache rebuilds.

rules.name: CleanShot X caches and logs
rules.description: CleanShot temporary caches/logs; not saved screenshots folder.
rules.notes: Do not delete user screenshot save destinations.

rules.name: Paste app caches and logs
rules.description: Paste clipboard manager regenerable caches (not full history DB by default).
rules.notes: Medium: users may consider clipboard history valuable; only caches here.

rules.name: 1Password logs only
rules.description: 1Password diagnostic logs. Never vaults, keychain, or .op data.
rules.notes: STRICT: never Application Support vaults, 1Password8 data, or keychains.

rules.name: Bitwarden desktop Chromium caches and logs
rules.description: Bitwarden Electron caches/logs; not encrypted vault data.
rules.notes: Leaves data.json encrypted vault blob; user re-syncs from server.

rules.name: Postman caches and logs
rules.description: Postman Chromium caches, fsCachedData, and logs. Not collections by default.
rules.notes: Does not delete Postman_Config or storage collections; close Postman first.

rules.name: Insomnia caches and logs
rules.description: Insomnia HTTP client Chromium caches and logs.
rules.notes: Leaves insomnia*.db request collections.

rules.name: TablePlus caches and logs
rules.description: TablePlus UI/query caches and logs. Not connection configs.
rules.notes: Never delete ConnectionHub.plist or keychain-backed passwords.

rules.name: Figma desktop caches and logs
rules.description: Figma desktop Electron caches and logs.
rules.notes: Design files live in cloud; local cache regenerable.

rules.name: Element (Matrix) desktop caches
rules.description: Element Electron caches and logs.
rules.notes: Leaves IndexedDB crypto stores; only Chromium disk caches.

rules.name: Mattermost and Rocket.Chat caches
rules.description: Mattermost Desktop and Rocket.Chat Chromium caches.
rules.notes: Server-side history; local cache only.

rules.name: Caprine Franz Rambox Station caches
rules.description: Multi-service messenger shell Chromium caches.
rules.notes: May require re-login if sessions bound to service workers (still cache-focused).

rules.name: BlueJeans GoToMeeting Viber caches
rules.description: Additional meeting/chat client caches and logs.
rules.notes: Skip Viber message DBs under Application Support/ViberPC.

rules.name: Asana ClickUp Todoist Trello desktop caches
rules.description: Work tracker Electron/desktop caches.
rules.notes: Cloud task data; caches only.

rules.name: Microsoft Edge WebView caches for Office/Teams
rules.description: Shared WebView2/EdgeWebView cache used by Office/Teams components under user Caches.
rules.notes: May affect multiple Microsoft apps; default off.

rules.name: pCloud desktop caches and logs
rules.description: pCloud client caches (not mounted cloud files).
rules.notes: Do not delete synced pCloud Drive content.

rules.name: Yandex Telemost/kTalk caches
rules.description: Yandex meeting/chat client caches and logs if installed.
rules.notes: Verified pattern from Electron ktalk installs.

rules.name: Spark mail client caches
rules.description: Readdle Spark caches and logs (not mailbox data if offline).
rules.notes: Medium: offline mail cache can be large; regenerable from server.

rules.name: Discord PTB/Canary/Development caches
rules.description: Alternate Discord release channels Chromium cache dirs beyond stable trio.
rules.notes: Stable Cache/Code/GPU already in apps.yaml; this covers channels.

rules.name: Zoom auxiliary logs and WebView2 cache
rules.description: Zoom installer/aomhost/CptHost logs and Webview2 cache under user Library.
rules.notes: Does not remove Zoom Plugins (may include user-installed plugins).

rules.name: Notion Calendar (Cron) caches
rules.description: Notion Calendar / Cron Electron caches.
rules.notes: Calendar events re-sync; leave Local Storage for session.

rules.name: Collab app ShipIt updater caches
rules.description: Sparkle/ShipIt download caches for common Electron collab apps.
rules.notes: Updater downloads only; apps re-fetch updates.

rules.name: Beekeeper Sequel Ace DB client caches
rules.description: Additional SQL client caches related to collab engineering stack.
rules.notes: Never delete connection plists or keychain items.
